question.text: In Williamson synthesis of mixed ether having a primary and a tertiary alkyl group if tertiary halide is used, then :

options.text: Rate of reaction will be slow due to slow cleavage of carbon-halogen bond.
Alkene will be the main product.
Simple ether will form instead of mixed ether.
Expected mixed ether will be formed.

solution.text: The tertiary alkyl halide undergo elimination reaction to give alkenes
